name: NAO
summary: NAO is a 58 cm programmable humanoid from Aldebaran, widely used in schools, universities and RoboCup. The current V6 has 25 DoF, two 5 MP cameras and runs 60-90 minutes per charge. About 20,000 units have been sold, and resellers still list it.
sensors: Two 5 MP cameras, four microphones, sonar, tactile sensors, IMU.
compute: Intel Atom E3845 1.91 GHz, 4 GB RAM, 32 GB eMMC.
highlights: Generation Robots lists NAO V6 at EUR 10,020 incl. VAT (EUR 8,350 excl. VAT).
About 20,000 NAO units sold in 70 countries.
Maxvision (Shenzhen) bought Aldebaran's core assets, including NAO, in July 2025.
caveats: Short battery life of about 60-90 minutes.
Ownership changed after Aldebaran's 2025 bankruptcy; long-term support depends on Maxvision.

sources.title: Maxvision buys core robot assets of Aldebaran, including Nao and Pepper
